title: The Star-Eater's Wake
synopsis: A perilous deep-space expedition through uncharted stellar nurseries and blinding magnetar storms. Leo and Astrid witness the sublime majesty and terror of dying stars while evading the relentless pursuit of Commodore Hawke's Dominion fleet. Amidst catastrophic radiation leaks and high-g drift maneuvers, feelings unspoken erupt into passionate devotion.

chapters.title: Edge of the Abyss
chapters.summary: Entering the forbidden Star-Eater sector; gravitational gradients and glowing purple plasma.

chapters.title: The Magnetar's Pulse
chapters.summary: A nearby magnetar emits periodic gamma-ray bursts; precision orbital timing required.

chapters.title: The Silent Cathedrals
chapters.summary: Encountering crystal-dense comet rings; breathtaking cosmic majesty and silence.

chapters.title: Radiation Lockout
chapters.summary: Shield failure forces the crew into the heavily leaded storm shelter; forced intimacy in cramped quarters.

chapters.title: Stolen Breaths
chapters.summary: Leo and Astrid confront the reality of their mortality; passionate embrace amidst alarm lights.

chapters.title: The Ghost Signal Decoded
chapters.summary: Orlo deciphers the beacon: an ancient automated gateway leading toward Sol's perimeter.

chapters.title: The Corsair Council
chapters.summary: Astrid calls a holographic council of pirate captains; warning them of Dominion mobilization.

chapters.title: Betrayal at the Coordinates
chapters.summary: A traitor captain leaks their rendezvous point to Commodore Hawke.

chapters.title: The Trap Springs
chapters.summary: Dominion cruisers jump out of sub-light, surrounding the small fleet.

chapters.title: Silent Fleet Warfare
chapters.summary: Massive railgun barrages, PDCs lighting the void, silent thermonuclear torpedo detonations.

chapters.title: The Marauder's Stand
chapters.summary: Astrid maneuvers between two capital ships, using their own crossfire against them.

chapters.title: Leo's High-G Burn
chapters.summary: Taking the secondary flight helm, Leo pulls an 11-G vector change to rescue a friendly corvette.

chapters.title: Armor Pierced
chapters.summary: A kinetic slug shears through the Marauder's forward radiator wing; fire in the starboard nacelle.

chapters.title: Spacewalk Under Fire
chapters.summary: Leo and Orlo suit up to manually eject the burning radiator before it cooks the fusion reactor.

chapters.title: The Magnetar Flare
chapters.summary: A massive pulse from the magnetar blinds all radar and thermal sensors across the battle sphere.

chapters.title: Blind Navigation
chapters.summary: Leo flies blind using inertial dead-reckoning, slipping the Marauder into the magnetar's shadow.

chapters.title: Casualties of the Void
chapters.summary: Tending to the wounded in the cargo deck; Astrid's grief and Leo's comforting touch.

chapters.title: Vows in the Dark
chapters.summary: Astrid and Leo acknowledge that they are inseparable; a promise to see Earth together.

chapters.title: The Gateway Discovered
chapters.summary: The ancient pre-collapse Jump Ring stands dormant before them, wrapped in cosmic dust.

chapters.title: The Key Turned
chapters.summary: Activating the gateway; the ring pulses with sapphire light as the Dominion closes in.
